planned_trials.hypothesis: Test mild horizontal flips and contrast changes with the strongest ten-epoch scheduled protocol.
Test label smoothing 0.05 with all other best-protocol settings held fixed.
Increase rare-class emphasis by changing inverse-frequency exponent from 0.5 to 0.75.
Matched continuation control: start at best layer4 weights and use four additional low-rate epochs with a fresh optimiser and scheduler.
From the same best layer4 checkpoint, unfreeze layer3 at 1e-6; compare with the identical layer4-only continuation.

decision_rule: Compare verified best checkpoints and per-class recalls plus missed faults/false alarms; retain reference if no higher macro-F1. No guarantee that any candidate improves. Each trial starts independently; do not combine settings adaptively in this batch.
timing_scope: Runner wall time includes initialization, train, two validation passes, metrics and logging; excludes external checkpoint verification and inherited parent training. Report incremental and cumulative cost for warm starts. Same inference graph and parameter count as reference for all arms; layer3 changes trainable count only.
